title: EWSAtlas v5: a harmonized single-cell and single-nucleus reference for Ewing sarcoma
description: Integrated single-cell/single-nucleus atlas of Ewing sarcoma assembled from six public studies: 138,353 cells, 16,622 genes, 65 samples, 38 patients. Includes the released analysis object, a CELLxGENE-schema deposit object, the trained scVI model for scArches reference mapping, and all result tables. SEE docs/14_deposition.md - creators, license and related identifiers must be completed by the depositors before upload.
license: TO BE CHOSEN (cc-by-4.0 is the usual choice for a derived atlas)
